title_zh: 约好转交反复耳鸣的回电请求

scenario.label_zh: 约好转交反复耳鸣的回电请求
scenario.goal_zh: 向诊所说明耳鸣反复出现的时间情况，并约定由接待员转交请临床人员回电的请求

context_zh: 虚构诊所电话场景，成人患者向接待员描述情况并请求专业人员联系；不提供诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Could I speak to a general practitioner about a persistent ringing in my left ear?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Patel
sentences.text: I can pass on a message. When did you first notice it, and is it happening now?

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: The first occurrence was on Monday evening. It has come back each day, and I can hear it now.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Patel
sentences.text: I’ll include that in the message and ask a clinician to call you today. I can’t assess the cause myself.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Thank you. I’ll keep my phone with me so I can explain it directly.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Patel
sentences.text: I have your current number here. I’ll send the callback request now.

targets.sense_zh: 持续存在或反复出现的
